title: OpsMetrics
description: live/metrics.json: operational metrics and freshness per layer, written every minute.

sources.description: One entry per source, in Source order.

LayerFreshness.description: Age of each layer, seconds; null when unknown.

live_feed_age_seconds.description: Time since the live manifest was last written.

silver_lag_seconds.description: Age of the oldest spooled batch not yet in silver; 0 when the spool is drained.

gold_age_seconds.description: Time since the latest gold build; null before the first one.

SourceMetrics.description: Throughput, latency and completeness of one source.

series_start.description: Start of the first minute in flashes_per_minute, a whole minute.

flashes_per_minute.description: Flashes published per minute of ingest_time, oldest first, at most 60; the last minute is in progress. Starts later than 60 minutes ago after a restart.

latency_p50_seconds.description: Median time from event_time to publication in the live feed, last 60 minutes; null without flashes.

latency_p95_seconds.description: 95th percentile of the same latency; null without flashes.

completeness.description: Product files spooled in the last 60 minutes over the expected count, 0 to 1; null when the source has no file in 30 days.

last_file_time.description: When the latest product file of this source was spooled; null if never.

error_budget_remaining.description: Share of the 30-day completeness error budget left: 1 untouched, 0 spent, negative when overspent; null when the source has no file in 30 days.

CheckStatus.description: Overall check result: fail if an error check failed, warn if only warnings did.

QualityStatus.description: Latest results of the data quality checks on silver.

checked_at.description: When the most recent check ran; null if none has.

failed.description: Names of the checks whose latest result failed.

CatalogUsage.description: Iceberg catalog operations this month against the free tier.

operations.description: Catalog operations made by lake-writer this month.

free_tier.description: Operations included each month by the catalog provider.

LakeSize.description: Size of the Iceberg tables, from the summary of each table's current snapshot, measured about every hour. Files kept only for older snapshots, metadata and other objects in the bucket are not counted.

measured_at.description: When the snapshots were read; null before the first measurement.

tables.description: Tables in the bronze, silver and gold namespaces; null before the first measurement.

bytes.description: Data files of the current snapshots, bytes; null before the first measurement.

data_files.description: Data files of the current snapshots; null before the first measurement.

records.description: Rows of the current snapshots; null before the first measurement.

StormCounts.description: Storms in the catalog after its latest hourly publication.

measured_at.description: When the storm catalog was last published; null before the first publication.

detected.description: Storms tracked and classified in the lake, every intensity level; null before the first publication.

published.description: Storms with a public page: intensity level 3 and above; null before the first publication.

highlighted.description: Storms featured in the highlights; null before the first publication.
